name: toast-41
description: Removing a team member from a row menu confirms with a destructive-styled toast.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Ellipsis as EllipsisIcon, UserMinus as UserMinusIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dropdown-menu" import { Toaster, createToastManager } from "@workspace/ui/components/toast" const notify = createToastManager() const initialMembers = [ { name: "Ali Imam", role: "Admin" }, { name: "Studio Designer", role: "Editor" }, { name: "Client", role: "Viewer" }, ] export default function RemoveMemberToast() { const [members, setMembers] = React.useState(initialMembers) return (
{members.map((m) => (
{m.name .split(" ") .map((p) => p[0]) .join("")} {m.name} {m.role} } > { setMembers((prev) => prev.filter((x) => x.name !== m.name)) notify.add({ type: "error", title: m.name + " removed", description: "They lost access to all projects.", }) }} > Remove
))}
) }
